bullets.content: [general] Change one factor per solve (h OR one refinement's size/radius/place) and compare previous vs new mesh. Never call compare(a,a). Read regions[0].at and nearest_group to place the next refinement.

[general] One factor per solve, strictly. Before each solve write the exact diff vs the previous solved mesh; if it lists >1 item, split it (a solve changing h, f23, edges and flanks at once taught nothing).

[general] After every solve read top-5 hotspots, the per-group size table and view(kind=error). If a refinement's touching h exceeds 1.3x the request (f2 0.003→0.0043), fix that next, not h. Refine where share >=5% and local h >~0.6x low-error h.
[general] Use all 4 solves, one factor each: candidate, x0.75 reference, one far-field/point-robustness variant, one cost variant. Submit if compare diff <=0.03. compare(prev,new) each time.
[general] Choose submission by score proxy (g/2)^2/c (error ratio times DOF ratio), with e from compare() of coarsest vs finest; not lowest error or strain energy magnitude. Compute for each solve.

[general] After every one-factor solve, view(kind=error) and check the targeted region's hotspot shares fell; compare numbers alone (0.15-0.17) can't separate remeshing noise from gain. Before solving, check where the box ends relative to top-share error cells.

[general] Call view(kind=error) after solve 1 every run (promised, skipped). Read hotspots' local h; revert a coarsened box holding a hotspot. If compare(candidate, reference) top regions sit in low-stress far field, add a moderate far-field box.
[general] When a box sets the local size, an h-only sweep gives little change; vary box size instead of h.
[general] Bracket, don't drift: plan one cheaper and one finer variant around the baseline so the e·DOFs optimum is bracketed. Use all 4 solves.
[general] compare() diffs ≤0.12-0.17 (7-8% energy norm at 13-18k DOFs) are remeshing noise. Always compare candidate vs baseline; treat such solves as tied and submit the cheaper.
[general] Accept the finer mesh only if energy gain % / DOF increase % >= 0.075 (0.98%/11.4% = 0.086 accepted). Compare two DIFFERENT solves only; compare() carries 0.12-0.17 noise.
[general] A refinement smaller than ~0.35x global h may not reach its size (f2 0.003 under h 0.009 gave 0.0045). Pair small targets with a covering box or finer h, and verify touching h.
[general] After each mesh call read per-group element sizes before solving. If small fillet faces drop below 0.75x median while hotspot faces don't, DOFs are wasted: revert h rather than solve.
[general] Read min_quality before solving. 0.1099 (h 0.012, edges 0.002 r0.005) is near-invalid. If <0.12, raise smallest edge size to 0.0024 or radius to >=0.004 and re-mesh first.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Note the active mesh before every solve(). Price recipes with mesh() first; quality sliver 0.1103 appears at every h<=0.008 but vanishes at h 0.0085+, so coarse h 0.0125 is safe.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Older reference recipe a8 (base 0.247): a3 recipe plus flank boxes [0.009,-0.016,0.019,0.023,0.016,0.033] and mirror at 0.0035 r0.005 (+3.5k DOFs). Superseded by g6 solve 4 frame.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Flank test 0.0036->0.0031 targets rim hotspots (h 0.0046). Pay line: energy >=0.03364 J for <=+12% DOFs. Peers: 0.0036->0.003 gave +11% nodes for +0.78% energy; 0.003->0.0026 failed. Stop at 0.003.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Boxes deliver ~1.3x requested size in this thin wall (0.0036 flanks gave rim h 0.0046-0.0047). After solve 1 check hotspot #1/#2 local h; if >0.0042 the request is too coarse.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Never refine f23 or f20 group instead of a body box: f23 0.0048-0.0055 without body box gave 0.03278/0.03091 J vs 0.0331-0.0334 with it.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring (z 0.0561 cells, ~14%) is saturated in every run. Keep f2 0.0025 r0.005 + edge 40 0.0025 r0.004; spend nothing more there.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Between-boss wall cells (±0.0058, ±0.0129, z 0.0255) held 12.6%. Highlight a15: junction zone [-0.024,-0.018,0.018,0.024,0.018,0.038] 0.004 r0.006 under flanks 0.003 dropped them to 2.5% (field 17.4%, 21456 DOFs). Or test front/back boxes [-0.012,0.009,0.02,0.012,0.018,0.035]+mirror 0.0036.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 8/39 overlap flanks: solve with edges 0.0022 and no flanks gave 0.03311 J at 18.0k DOFs. If flank 0.0031 pays, test dropping edges 8/39 (~300-400 nodes saved). Edge 8/40 at 0.0024 never reached hotspots; also try loosening to 0.003.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Uniform 0.0054 body box plus 0.0025 edge/f2 gave 17.7% at 20.1k DOFs, worse e*DOFs than a3 (0.0058, 15.5k, base 0.233). Spend savings on targeted junction cells.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Rim hotspots (|x|~0.02,|y|~0.007,z~0.03: 21-22%) persist with flanks 0.0036. Try face refinements f16/f19/f18 at 0.003 r0.004 instead of flank boxes.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Top band z 0.05-0.06 cells hold ~3.6% each with 130-190% local error. Test box [-0.021,-0.02,0.045,0.021,0.02,0.0615] 0.003 r0.004 against body box.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Split radii factors: S1 both radius changes; S2 flank r0.010 only with body r0.008. compare(1,2) and vs a8 (18945 DOFs). If min_quality <0.12 with body r0.005, retry r0.006.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Use one solve as a cheap bracket at ~14k DOFs (body 0.0065, no edge refinements) to bracket e*DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Any body box must reach zmax 0.0575. Box to z 0.04 left top band (x±0.006, y±0.013, z 0.05-0.06, cells at z 0.0561) with ~19% of error at h ~0.005. Extend there (zmin 0.045, zmax 0.0615, size 0.003) rather than shrinking the lower box.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Under a body box covering |x|≤0.021, h 0.007-0.012 changes nodes only 5155-5564: never spend a solve on h-only. When shrinking body radius keep shaft h ≤0.009 (check f3/f16 touching h); cells near f3 x 0.029 are contested.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] f2 0.003 r0.005 gives touching h 0.0043-0.0045 under any h 0.008-0.012; clamp-ring cells hold ~13% of error. To test the clamp use box [-0.02,-0.02,0.05,0.02,0.02,0.0605] at 0.0035 r0.004 (a8: +2.5k DOFs, compare 0.152, not proportional); else leave.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a3: h 0.012 plus one body box 0.0058 to z 0.0575 and edges 39/8/40 gave base 0.233 at 15.5k DOFs; covering the whole wall cheaply beats dense partial boxes.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction box [-0.022,-0.016,0.02,0.022,0.016,0.034] at 0.0042 r0.004 under body 0.0058 cost +2.2k DOFs; boss-root cells stayed h 0.0046-0.0049 (~23% error). A box must be ≤0.6x its surroundings (≤0.0035). Mid-band box 0.0042 also gave no gain.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Persistent hotspots: f16/f19 rims |x| 0.019-0.020, |y|~0.007, z 0.029-0.031 (22-27% VM at h 0.0045-0.0057); f20 saddle |x|~0.013, |y|~0.009, z 0.022-0.025. Edge radius r0.009 didn't reach them.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Lower wall z 0-0.018 holds no top cell. Box 0.0038 over z 0-0.04 put ~2100 elements on f23 for little gain; body-wide 0.0045-0.0058 suffices. Box 0.0048->0.0038 raised DOFs 17.3k->23.3k, marginal score gain.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Worst hidden check point near f21 (0.0058,-0.0043,0.056) at h ~0.005 (RMS 10.2%); try f21 0.003 r0.004.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Field error binds (18.7% vs 7.9% points). Choose by field error times DOF ratio; a +35% DOF solve pays only if error drops ≥15%. Compare top two candidates before submitting.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup f2 fixed, 4e6 Pa on f23, 2.1e6 Pa on f16, 3D, E 210e9, nu 0.3; good equilibrium. Keep verbatim.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Setup: f12 fixed, pressure 2.1e6 Pa on f7, 3D, E 210e9, nu 0.3. Correct, good equilibrium in all runs. Keep verbatim.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Global h on a14/a2 boxes is noise: h 0.0075 gave 6195 nodes, 7.75% field; h 0.007 gave 5655 nodes, 8.86%; e*DOFs flat ~1440, points swung 6.9-11.4%. Never spend solves on h-only sweeps.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Strain energy ranked true field error over 8 runs (2.13874e-4→7.47% ... 2.12925e-4→9.54%). Calibration: true field = ~1.2x compare(candidate, x0.75 ref) for P2 refs ~30k DOFs here. Above target choose lowest e·DOFs.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp band (z≈-0.0072) holds ~32-40% of error at h 0.0021-0.0025 but is saturated (4% VM). Keep tier1 0.0016, never above 0.0018. Structural test: f12 face 0.0025 r0.003.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Highlight a4 (base 0.763, 17.1k DOFs, field 8.15%, points 8.06%): one graded clamp box 0.0016 r0.007 instead of three tiers, upper box 0.0038. Upper 0.0045→0.0038 changed field 6% for +4% DOFs.
